title: Double and Single Intrauterine Insemination In Controlled Ovarian Stimulation (COH) Cycles With Multifollicular Development
brief_summary: Our hypothesis is double insemination will improve pregnancy rates in coh cycles with more than one dominant follicles (\>16mm).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Unexplained and mild male factor infertile patients
* Minimum 2 follicles \>16 mm at the day of HCG
* First 3 cycles

Exclusion Criteria:

* Basal FSH \>12 mIU/L
* Total antral follicle count\<6
* Severe male factor infertility
